steps.name: Raise requisition with automated budget approval
steps.description: Requester submits a requisition that the system validates against cost centre budget and supplier master data, approving it automatically within threshold and routing breaches to the cost centre manager.

steps.name: Auto-issue purchase order
steps.description: System issues the purchase order from the approved requisition and dispatches it to the supplier without manual conversion.

steps.name: Match and post supplier invoice
steps.description: Accounts payable system matches the supplier invoice against the purchase order and goods receipt note, posting the payable when all three agree and raising an exception otherwise.

disposition_mapping.rationale: DUMMY. Requisition entry is merged with approval into the single step TS-01, where validation happens at point of entry.
DUMMY. Approval is merged into TS-01 as an automated budget check with exception routing. The control still exists and is still evidenced; it is no longer a separate manual step.
DUMMY. Purchase order issue remains a distinct step but is performed by the system on approval rather than by a procurement officer.
DUMMY. The three-way match is carried over substantially unchanged in TS-03, with the system performing the comparison the clerk performed by hand.
